text:
maria: Heads-up — weather apps are calling for heavy rain Sunday afternoon. Who's doing what this weekend? Options: boardgames at my place (I have Catan + Wingspan), a quick lakeside walk if it clears, or bike tune-up + coffee at noon. Bring snacks?

alex: Boardgames sound perfect. I vote Wingspan, but I can bring card sleeves and snacks. :chips: :coffee:

jamie: Ooh Wingspan. Also can host if people want quieter space. I have a big table. @maria you good with swapping?

maria: @jamie yes love that — saves me from tidying. I can bring the game boxes and cookies.

noah: If it actually rains I'd rather be inside. Count me in for boardgames. Can bring a playlist.

sophia: I was going to try the lakeside run but will bail if it's pouring. If it's sunny I'm down. Otherwise boardgames + tea for me. :tea:

alex: Also low-key tempted by bike tune-up, my chain's been noisy. Could do a quick swap — bikes + games tradeoff.

maria: Plan: if forecast still shows heavy rain by 10am Sunday we do boardgames at @jamie's at 1pm. If it's dry, meet at the lakeside path at 11am for a walk and coffee after. No bikes block unless a volunteer mechanic shows up. :umbrella: :game_die:

devbot: Reminder: @channel "Board Game Meetup" event created for Sunday 13:00 at Jamie's place. RSVP: https://calendar.redwood.dev/events/2391234567

jamie: RSVP yes — I'll text the address to the thread in DMs. Anyone allergic to nuts?

noah: Nope, nut-free in my bag.

alex: I'm allergic to strawberries but cookies are fine without them.

maria: Great — I'll bake nut-free chocolate chip. See you all then! :sparkles:
